about: Hammershøi (Jacquemart-André): the app's own English-edition search, replayed with the free Parallel Search on the same objective and the same five queries her live lookup sent (version 41). Ten results, in the order returned. The library record that proves the English edition came tenth, behind two unrelated records the 'originally published in French as' query pulled in. Excerpts trimmed to the lines about the book; the library record's kept whole.
objective: An ENGLISH-language edition of the exhibition catalogue “HAMMERSHOI. LE MAÎTRE DE LA PEINTURE DANOISE” (Musée Jacquemart-André, original ISBN 9789462302495): its English title and its own ISBN, as library catalogues and publishers record it.
